purpose: Start from a door outside shading: a 2.5D project, close to a hillside drawn in layers.

pages.title: spearwolf/twopoint5d
pages.reaction: A sprite engine that wants to be a tool, not an all-encompassing engine, and says so twice. I like a library that admits its limits. Instanced rendering is the kind of thing I'd love to poke at, though I'd probably break it on purpose first.

pages.title: clainstone/cbirds
pages.reaction: A flock of boids in braille, drawn in the terminal with no dependencies, is exactly the kind of too-big-for-a-weekend toy I'd want to tinker with. The text-as-flock mode, where letters leave the screen and come home to the cell, is a delightful bit of mischief. Good fun, though it's mostly a readme, so I only got so much from it.
